description_en: Thephalcāwas moved back and reconstructed due to anticipated road widening in 2011. The Dhime Maṅkākhala group looks after it. Thephalcāhas three bays on its front and two on its sides. Its wall is made ofdacī apā, and five layers of terracotta bricks separate the first floor from the ground floor. Eighteen plain struts support the hip roof, which is covered with Indian tiles. Three metal pinnacles have been fixed on the top of the roof.In 2011, thephalcāwas reconstructed in a smaller size than its original shape and was shifted five feet away from the main road in anticipation of the planned road widening project. At the same time, two stone statues of Gaṇeśa and of Sarasvatī were inserted into the rear wall, and half a storey and a hip roof were also added. Previously, it used to be apāli phalcā(i. e., aphalcāwith separate rooms for sleeping). The historical carved struts that have been placed in the back corners of the platform were brought from the Haribhajana Phalcā (SUN4070). The Dhime Maṅkākhala group looks after the Dampāchẽ Phalcā. The previoushalipatāand other ritual objects are stored in thisphalcā. Heritage architects Padma Sundar Maharjan and Sabina Tandukar state that, "the Yāḥ guthi people responsible for its caretaking sleeps overnight on this Phalcā. This marks the official beginning of the three-day festival." (Maharjan and Tandukar: Jatra route and its connection, p. 2)
description_ne: सुनागुथिको मूल सडकको पश्चिमपट्टि दम्पाछेँ फल्चा रहेको छ । यस फल्चाको मोहडा भागमा तीन वटा कवल छन् भने दायाँबायाँ एक-एक कवल छन् । फल्चाको माथिल्लो होचो तलालाई अलग देखाउन निदालमाथि टेराकोटा ईंटको प्रयोग गरी पाँच तहको बुट्टा बनाइएको छ । चारैतिर भिरालो परेको अनि भारतबाट आयातीत टायलले छाइएको छानोलाई अड्याउन अठारवटा सादा टुँडाल राखिएका छन् अनि छानामाथि तीनवटा धातुका गजुर राखिएका छन् ।सन् २०११ मा पहिलाको आकारभन्दा केही सानो आकारमा यो फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । सो निर्माणको क्रममा फल्चालाई बाटोबाट पाँच फिट पछाडि हटाइएको थियो र भित्तामा गणेश र सरस्वतीको मूर्ति थपिएको थियो । पुनर्निर्माणभन्दा पहिला फल्चामा पाली थियो जसमा सुत्नको लागि अलग कोठा पनि थियो । पुनर्निर्माणकै क्रममा माथिल्लो आधा तला थपिएको थियो । फल्चामा कुनै शिलालेख छैन, पछाडिका कष्ठस्तम्भसँगै अड्याएर राखिएका दुई कुँशल टुँडालबाहेक अरू सबै संरचना नयाँ देखिन्छन् । ती टुँडाल यस फल्चाको उत्तरपट्टि रहेको हरिभजन फल्चाका (SUN4070) हुन् । धिमे मंकाः खलःले यस फल्चाको रेखदेख गर्ने गर्दछ ।

historical_events.event_description: Locals reconstructed the Phalcā in 2011. In the reconstruction process, the Phalcā was moved five feet back from its original position to protect it from road-widening. The statues of Gaṇeśa and Sarasvatī were also added during this time.
